rationale: direction_sign is the spine's sign: 1 favourable, -1 unfavourable for risk appetite or the named entity (references/typing_prompt_v1.txt rule 8). Textbook data-release channel. A favourable release lifts risk_appetite (+; SPY +, IWM +, HYG +). There is no rates edge: growth and inflation surprises move rates in the same direction from opposite signs, so no single signed edge serves both; a growth/inflation split is a later refinement. Documentation, not data.
